Description: Transmission of the virus from infectious to susceptible individuals, dependent on the daily contact rate c.
Progression from the exposed to the infectious state at a rate ε.
Recovery or removal of infectious individuals from the population at a rate r.

Name: r
Description: Average rate of recovery or removal. Proxied by the median of time lags from illness onset to reported case.
Value: Inverse of the average infectious period

Name: ε
Description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious, equal to the inverse of the average time spent exposed (incubation period).

Name: c
Description: Daily contact rate, calculated as the basic reproduction rate (R0) divided by the average days from onset to first medical visit and isolation.

Name: Incubation Period
Description: The average time spent exposed but not infectious (1/ε).

Name: Infectious Period
Description: Average days from onset to first medical visit and isolation, used to calculate the contact rate c.
